verdict.rationale: Morph is delivered purely as an API/SDK (OpenAI-compatible endpoint) with no UI dependency, and explicitly supports batch/offline automation ('Run thousands of chat completions offline at half price') plus programmatic job polling for Reflex training — both naturally scriptable in CI. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), and independent hands-on confirmation of headless/CI usage beyond docs.
